_note: Planning assumptions, not quotes. APRs approximate Experian State of the Automotive Finance Market averages for USED vehicles. Refresh quarterly. Insurance figures approximate national full-coverage averages by vehicle class.

channel_price_multipliers._note: Relative to a franchised or independent dealer retail asking price for the same car. Auction figure is hammer price; add buyer fees and broker fee.

mileage_adjustment._note: Percent change in value per 10,000 miles above or below expected mileage for the car's age.
